test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C are three numbers. A is 45% more than B and C is 60% less than A. By what percent (to the nearest integer) B is more than C?
solution:
Given:

A, B and C are three numbers. A is 45% more than B and C is 60% less than A.

Calculation:

Let B be 100.

A = 100 + 100 × 45% = 145

C = 145 - 145 × 60% = 58

Now, % more = {{100 - 58} over 58} times 100\%

⇒ 72.41%

∴ B is 72% more than C.
